edge.title: Zero-init biases, drop CGI gains, fixed ref interpolation from 2850
edge.summary: A clean rewrite of the #40 stack (Aurora/SOAP/Contra/radial-brake/u-w floor/EMA-Nesterov unchanged; zero-weight Soft-Muon and trust-gate code deleted) with three behavioral changes: all non-projection biases (q/k/v/mlp.fc) start at zero instead of nn.Linear's U(±1/√768), the CGI Rademacher gain split is dropped (α 0.14→0, all norm gains start at 1), and validations from step 2850 use a fixed reference interpolation θ_eval = 0.925·θ + 0.075·θ_2375 over all float parameters, applied and then undone. Training stops at 2860 while the 2900/2980 schedule horizon is kept. The readout rule and constants (capture 2375, γ=−0.075) are those introduced in #38, here moved onto the EMA-Nesterov branch and applied from 2850 instead of 2900.

changes.label: Fixed reference interpolation ≥2850
changes.detail: maybe_capture_ref_extrap_state copies all float params to CPU after update 2375; validations with step ≥ 2850 (2850 and 2860) apply θ += −0.075·(θ − θ_2375) via apply_ref_extrap_weights, evaluate, then restore_ref_extrap_weights.

changes.label: Zero-init all non-proj biases
changes.detail: The init loop now also zeroes every parameter ending in 'bias' (q/k/v and mlp.fc biases; proj biases were already zero), replacing PyTorch's default uniform bias init.

changes.label: CGI Rademacher gain init
changes.detail: CGI_ALPHA = 0.0 and the gain-split block is deleted, so norm1/norm2 gains start at 1 (DI-fc α=0.30 kept).

changes.label: Stop at 2860, horizon unchanged
changes.detail: The loop runs to RUN_STOP_STEP=2860 (evals {2850, 2860}); TRAIN_STEPS=2900 still sets the μ cooldown (2800–2900) and EMA-Nesterov rest step 1950, SCHEDULE_STEPS=2980 the PowerCool end.

changes.label: Minimal rewrite of #40 code
changes.detail: Soft-Muon (zero blend), attn.proj trust gate, SOAP-mode switch, attention-fade and unused Muon weight_decay removed; V-SOAP path inlined as norm_preserving_soap_blend; NorMuon-lite code kept but inert (NOR_BETA2=1.0); CLI log options.

edge.parent_check: #40 confirmed despite the rewrite (textually nearest to #14 only because the script was minimized). Every active #40 component is present with identical constants: Muon (12-iter NS, μ 0.85↔0.95, cooldown over last 100 of 2900), SOAP on mlp.fc/mlp.proj (freq 10, β2 0.9) and attn.v (blend 0.95, floor 0.55, ungated), Aurora on mlp.proj (K=3, β=0.25), Contra −0.2→0 by 2500, radial brake 0.5/1.0 + radius pin, u/w floor 0.3825, PowerCool (2980, p=1.2, same c's), AdamW (0.3, 1/320, 0.01; β (0.8, 0.99)), proj zero-init, DI-fc 0.30, EMA-Nesterov (0.3·lr/lr0, 0.99, steps 300–1949). Only zero-effect #40 code was dropped and NorMuon-lite stays inert (β2=1). #14's distinctive settings (linear cooldown, u/w 0.35, live NorMuon-lite, Adam β2 0.95) are absent.
edge.noise: Whole-file rewrite: new docstring, constants renamed (FINAL_* → TRAIN_STEPS/SCHEDULE_STEPS/LR_POWER), Muon state init factored into _init_state, removed dead branches, --log-dir/--log-file/--progress-interval CLI args (console-only progress), ema_beta/ref_gamma log suffixes.

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon + SOAP (MLP, V) + Contra + Aurora (mlp.proj), inside EMA-Nesterov

mechanisms.name: Fixed reference interpolation
mechanisms.explain: Right after update 2375, maybe_capture_ref_extrap_state stores CPU copies of every floating-point parameter (embedding, lm head, gains, biases, hidden matrices). At each validation with step ≥ 2850, apply_ref_extrap_weights adds γ(θ − θ_2375) with γ = −0.075, so the model is evaluated at 0.925·θ + 0.075·θ_2375; restore_ref_extrap_weights subtracts the same deltas afterwards, leaving training untouched (same rule and constants as #38, which applied it only at 2900).

mechanisms.name: Zero-initialized biases
mechanisms.explain: The init loop zeroes every parameter whose name contains 'proj' (as before) and, with ZERO_NONPROJ_BIASES=True, every other parameter ending in 'bias', i.e. the q/k/v and mlp.fc biases that nn.Linear would otherwise draw from U(±1/√768). These biases remain trainable by the 1-D AdamW group (lr 0.01).

caveats: Table/README describe it as 'Setup from #40'; the reference-interpolation rule and constants match #38 exactly (capture 2375, γ=−0.075), although #38 is not listed as an influence, and here they apply from 2850 rather than 2900. The archived script hardcodes all values (no env overrides); logs ran on 8×L40S (world_size=8). #42 is a leaf: later records (#41/#43–#46) descend from #40/#41 and keep CGI gains and default bias init.
